title: Azusawa Kohane — The Biggest Bite I Can Muster〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: The Biggest Bite I Can Muster（4★）

rows.Line: A street near the New York Academy of Music

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Thank you very much for telling us about that burger shop!”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
“You're welcome!
Anyway, if you'll excuse me!”
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're checking out that record shop next, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we're supposed to go straight for a while and take a left.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Then, let's take this opportunity to walk off our meal!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The hamburgers at that shop were so yummy.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I had a feeling it'd be good, since he said that it's popular with the students.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And the atmosphere was so great.
It felt like the epitome of an all-American diner!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've never been to any place like that, so it was a new experience for me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
And the staff were all really nice.
They saw that we weren't used to conversing in English, so they made sure to speak slowly.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it was really easy to understand what they were saying.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not all the students are native English speakers, so they must know their customer base.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was wondering why we were able to hold a smooth conversation. I guess they're used to talking to people who don't exactly speak perfect English...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, we didn't make any mistakes with our orders after all?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, it's just...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The hamburgers they brought over were much bigger than I was expecting. I was worried that we asked for the wrong size.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I couldn't believe it either!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We ordered their standard size, and out came these burgers that were as big as our faces!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I immediately began to understand where the term “American size” in Japan originates.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously, those things were huge.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, the patties were like three times the size of what you'd normally get in Japan.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right. I did my best, but the patty on mine just seemed to dominate each bite I took.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was just too hard for me to fit in the buns and vegetables at the same time...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's perfectly understandable, Azusawa.
Even I had trouble getting everything into one bite.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Me too.
But you got pretty close to the middle, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Barely. But I doubt people are meant to just based on their sheer size.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which would explain why you had so much trouble, Kohane, since you like to take smaller nibbles.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But that was also why you looked so cute!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: C-Cute?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! First, it was so adorable how you picked up your burger and did everything you could to keep it from falling apart!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, this puzzled look came over you when you couldn't figure out where to start. That was also really cute.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But the best part was when you made your decision and went in for a big bite!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, An, you were watching me the entire time?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, duh! How could I not watch?! Seeing you try to figure it out was so cute!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-It was...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Still...
I was so focused that I didn't notice at all.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But this does make for a good story.
There's nothing more American than a burger, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'm looking forward to telling my classmates, Miku and the others all about this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, wait. We'll want to take over some actual hamburgers to SEKAI instead of just stories.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, good point!
We could definitely manage that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! They've all shown a lot of interest in American cuisine, so I'm sure they'd love to have some!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, before we head back to campus, let's pick up some more burgers at the same shop.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. They're going to be so surprised by how big they are.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I can't wait to see their faces!
